# Kartik Jain: full profile

> Kartik Jain is a security engineer and backend developer in Mumbai, India. He was awarded a $1,500 bug bounty by Meta (WhatsApp), has reported vulnerabilities to Microsoft (MSRC) and the Mumbai Police (via CERT-In), and builds production backends with Node.js, TypeScript, Python and PostgreSQL. He is a B.Tech IT student at NMIMS MPSTME, Mumbai (graduating 2028), Chairperson of ACM MPSTME, and open to internships and freelance work.

This is the long-form, machine-readable version of https://jkartik.in. Everything here is also on
the site or the résumé; the short version is https://jkartik.in/llms.txt. Last reviewed October 2026.

## Experience

### Software Engineer Intern, VisionRise Technosoft (Apr 2026 – Oct 2026, Mumbai)

- Built a white-label learning platform end to end: a Node.js/Express/TypeScript API (276 routes across
  20 domain modules, PostgreSQL with Drizzle) and a single React Native/Expo codebase for Android, iOS
  and web, shipped on Google Play as two branded apps, **Rise Academy** and **eGuru**.
- Protected paid video with AES-128-encrypted HLS (FFmpeg pipeline), per-session playback tokens and
  short-lived signed Google Cloud Storage URLs; certificates are SHA-256-verifiable.
- Built authentication (Google Sign-In, WhatsApp-verified PIN login, JWT access/refresh tokens) with
  role-based access for admins, instructors and students, and audit logs on admin actions.
- Integrated Zoom live classes (signature-verified webhooks, attendance, recordings) and generated
  quizzes from class content with Gemini.
- Provisioned and ran the company's production server: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Coolify CI/CD, PostgreSQL,
  automated backups to Google Cloud Storage. Administered the company's GitHub organization and Google
  Workspace.
- Write-up: https://jkartik.in/projects/white-label-lms/

### Security Engineer Intern, R.U.D.R.A Cybersecurity (May 2025 – Jul 2025, Mumbai)

R.U.D.R.A is a Mumbai-based VAPT / offensive-security firm.

- Found and reported two high-severity vulnerabilities (local file inclusion, broken access control) in
  a banking client's web portal through manual code review, then automated their detection with custom
  Nuclei templates.
- Built a custom Semgrep (SAST) module with Neo4j-based graph visualisation for large-scale code analysis.
- Automated recurring external attack-surface monitoring with BBOT, saving about $20,000 a year of
  manual recon.
- Deployed and operated the Sliver C2 framework for purple-team exercises.

### Freelance Backend & Security Engineer (May 2025 – Oct 2026)

Two separate engagements, not continuous work.

- **May – Jun 2025:** hardened the infrastructure of a web platform with 16,000+ users and led the
  incident response when it was hit by ransomware, restoring service through rapid backup and recovery.
- **Aug – Oct 2026:** built a live player-auction and scoring platform (Next.js, Supabase Postgres +
  Realtime) used at ELEV8, a ~200-player, 8-team pickleball tournament, with an offline write queue for
  unreliable venue Wi-Fi. Write-up: https://jkartik.in/projects/sports-live/

## Security research

Details are kept high-level on purpose. Full list: https://jkartik.in/research/

- **WhatsApp (Meta):** privilege-escalation vulnerability; awarded a **$1,500** bug bounty by Meta.
- **Microsoft:** access-control and information-disclosure issues in Microsoft Intune and the Exchange
  admin center, reported to the Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC).
- **Mumbai Police:** stored cross-site scripting (XSS) on the official website, disclosed in
  coordination with CERT-In.
- **The Souled Store:** reported exposed staging infrastructure.
- **Belgian Waffle Co.:** reported a source-code and credential leak.
- **Banking client (via R.U.D.R.A):** two high-severity findings, LFI and broken access control.
- **Defensive:** ransomware incident response and hardening for a 16,000+ user platform (freelance).

## Projects

All write-ups: https://jkartik.in/projects/

- **Rise Academy & eGuru** (VisionRise, 2026): white-label LMS; see Experience. https://jkartik.in/projects/white-label-lms/
- **GhostShare** (solo, 2026): end-to-end-encrypted, ephemeral realtime sharing with no accounts. Keys
  are derived in the browser with Argon2id and data is sealed with AES-256-GCM, so the server stores only
  ciphertext; encrypted 5 MiB chunks stream directly to Cloudflare R2 with parallel, resumable uploads;
  Socket.IO with a Redis adapter. Live at https://share.jkartik.in. https://jkartik.in/projects/ghostshare/
- **Railway Concession** (maintainer, Jul 2026 – present): MPSTME's official railway-concession system,
  used by ~4,000 students. Took it over and maintains it solo: migrated it to PostgreSQL, enforced an
  IST-aware booking window server-side, and built admin tools and automated daily reports for the college
  office. Live at https://concession.mpst.me. https://jkartik.in/projects/railway-concession/
- **Event and payment backends** (NMIMS student events): the Taqneeq tech-fest credits/loyalty backend
  (lead author; OTP login, referrals, cached live leaderboard); the FastAPI backend for Delego, the Mumbai
  MUN delegate app (2024–25 editions, 600+ delegates); co-led paid event registration on Cashfree with
  HMAC-verified webhooks; and conc-qr, QR access control for 500+ delegates at Social Conclave.
- **Fool The LLM** (solo, 2026): a prompt-injection contest platform where a guarded Gemini model hides a
  codeword; organizer console with live logs and per-player token budgets; about 70 participants in the
  latest edition. https://jkartik.in/projects/ftl/
- **bad-db** (solo, 2026): a database storage engine written from scratch in Java, with a custom on-disk
  format, a hand-rolled B-Tree index, tombstone deletes with compaction, and its own query language (BQL).
  https://github.com/KartikJain14/bad-db
- **Self-hosted infrastructure for college committees** (as ACM Webmaster, 2025–26): Coolify, and a Mailcow
  mail server with SPF, DKIM and DMARC shared by several college committees; GitHub organization and CI/CD.
  https://jkartik.in/projects/acm-infrastructure/
- **jkartik.in**: this site. Astro, multi-stage Docker image, GitHub Actions to GHCR, pull-based
  deploys with Watchtower. https://github.com/KartikJain14/jkartik.in

## Skills

- **Security:** web application penetration testing, VAPT, OWASP Top 10, Burp Suite, Nmap, Semgrep
  (SAST), Nuclei, BBOT, Sliver C2, manual code review, responsible disclosure, incident response, applied
  cryptography (AES-GCM, Argon2id, HMAC, signed URLs), LLM red teaming and prompt injection.
- **Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, Java, Go, Bash.
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express, Fastify, FastAPI, Flask, Next.js, REST API design, WebSockets/Socket.IO,
  JWT/OAuth 2.0, RBAC, Zod, BullMQ.
- **Data:** PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Firebase/Firestore, Supabase; Drizzle, Prisma.
- **DevOps and cloud:** Docker, Linux (Ubuntu) server administration and hardening, CI/CD (GitHub
  Actions, GHCR, Coolify), Nginx and TLS, backups and disaster recovery, Mailcow (SPF/DKIM/DMARC),
  Google Cloud Storage, Cloudflare R2.
- **Mobile:** React Native, Expo (EAS, OTA updates), Google Play publishing.
- **Languages spoken:** English, Hindi, Marwari.
